scope: Unmerged seventh ordered FreeCAD default DXF importer patch: bounded POLYFACE and polygon meshes on a common nondefault layer.
base: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e with the six previous default-importer patches applied.
change: Accept a nonempty parent layer only when every vertex and any explicit SEQEND layer exactly match it; retain parent common attributes for the collector. Mixed layers remain refused without partial mesh output.
baseline: An independently ezdxf-generated POLYFACE with parent, vertices, face and SEQEND on MESH was refused by the previous candidate; following LINE was retained.

validation.focused: Five focused FreeCAD importer tests pass on macOS ARM64, including new generated polyface/polygon controls with layers disabled and a headless Draft test double enabled. Matching-layer geometry and layer group membership are checked; mixed vertex or SEQEND layers are refused and following LINE retained. Existing bounded polyface, closed mesh and recovery tests pass.
validation.peerGenerated: ezdxf 1.4.4 generated same-layer POLYFACE and polygon meshes import with areas 6 and 12 square millimetres, while mixed layers are refused.
validation.nested: With layer preservation disabled, ezdxf-generated nested block profiles in inches and millimetres match analytically computed outer-link vertices and areas after two rotations; no unsupported feature reported. With layer preservation enabled, a later review found child layer membership was lost; apply the mandatory block-layer refusal correction.
validation.replay: Zero-context patch applies with git apply --unidiff-zero after the six-patch baseline; source and test files match the tested candidate byte-for-byte.

limits: Local sparse candidate and downstream patch remain unmerged; exact-string layer matching intentionally rejects differing case or mixed-layer records.
Layer-group assertions use a headless Draft test double because this FreeCAD build lacks Python Qt bindings; real GUI, native Draft, Linux/Windows and visual appearance are not qualified.
Per-face styling, invisible edges, nonplanar faces, smoothing and other unsupported metadata remain refused. No generated drawing is committed, and no support claim or phase gate is promoted.
The initial shared-layer patch must be followed by freecad-p8-default-block-mesh-layer-refusal-2026-11-16.patch; do not use it alone for layer-preserving block imports.
